verdict.rationale: Paxos documents broad API coverage of its core operations: identity onboarding, crypto and fiat transfers, fiat accounts and deposit instructions, conversions, mint/redeem orchestrations, orders, quotes, and event listing. However, the docs route webhook configuration and webhook test events through the Dashboard, and sandbox funding uses a Dashboard Fund button, which points to UI-only management features. Missing for 10: evidence of API endpoints for webhook creation/testing, API credential management, and sandbox funding; any explicit statement or independent verification of API/UI parity; a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).
